runtimeAssumption: The spike targets the repository's installed .NET 10 SDK. Ordinal comparison, invariant numeric formatting, and date parsing are locked by cross-runtime PowerShell vectors and must be revalidated before production migration.

replay-v1.numbers: signed 64-bit integers only; non-integral numeric CLR types rejected
replay-v1.strings: production replay escaping; U+007F and U+0000..U+001F escaped with lowercase hex

convention-v1.numbers: PowerShell object numeric rendering with invariant culture

productionSurfaces: acquisition and terminal canonical manifest SHA/HMAC
exact-text-v1.transformation: Strict UTF-8 file decoding followed by hashing the decoded text as BOM-free UTF-8; this matches production ReadAllText behavior, including consuming an input BOM.

domainDerivation: For each domains entry in order, replace key with HMAC-SHA256(key, UTF8(domain)); then sign the canonical bytes.
rootExclusion: excludeRootProperties removes only matching root object members before canonicalization; this models self-excluding manifestDigest fields without changing production artifacts.
